answer: Forgers face real capital loss, so cloning identities costs more than honest participation. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded proof-of-stake gate: each agent must lock a stake that a peer quorum can slash on proven duplicate identity. At dawn each epoch, validators on the mesa review attestations and flag clones, while a crystal-clear audit trail records every stake and slash so the network stays accountable.
